notes.title: Goo Hunter Featured on 24indie
notes.content:
A courageous slime, adorned with an adorable hat, embarks on a treasure-hunting adventure. With its unique mechanics and engaging gameplay, Goo Hunter promises to be a refreshing addition to the platforming genre.​

Read the full article here:
[url=https://24indie.com/goo-hunter-stick-swing-and-slime/]https://24indie.com/goo-hunter-stick-swing-and-slime/[/url]

Our sincere thanks to [url=https://24indie.com/]24indie[/url] for the feature — and to everyone supporting indie games like ours. Your encouragement keeps us going!
